scope: Fixed four-pair exploratory screen, one host per architecture; NOT final confidence or release qualification. All same-host fresh JVM arms, counterbalanced order, no exclusions; predeclared first-pair rejection only. Cold allocation includes first VectorUtil/Panama/helper initialization. Published output absolute tolerance 2e-6; history and candidate cold/hot repeat bits exact.
first_pair_rejection: Reject screen immediately after retaining first complete pair if candidate warm latency, cold allocated bytes, or warm allocated bytes exceeds the unchanged limit. This stopping rule may reject only; it cannot qualify or produce a passing final confidence claim.
